findings.claim: The unit-level cross-question coupling that G-STEM raised as a major on q:2 ("Cross-question leak … The pair is answerable without the passage") is still structurally live in the shipping unit, and no review stage recorded an adjudication of it; the only counter-evidence is a later G-STEM re-run that silently returned pass on an essentially unchanged option set.
findings.evidence: verdicts/verdicts-gstem.jsonl, q:2, severity major: "taken alone the four critiques are not separable blind (A is only a generic more-money complaint), but q:1 of the same set establishes the staffed-librarian finding across three of its four options, and B is the only critique that follows from it." That structure is unchanged in candidates-final: q1 A/C/D all assert a librarian-presence ↔ källkritik relation ("blev det vanligare att en bibliotekarie anställdes"; "Där en bibliotekarie fanns på plats flera dagar i veckan arbetade lärarna oftare med källkritik"; "Bemannade skolbibliotek ökade …"), and q2 B is the only critique that follows from a staffing thesis ("Att pengarna gick till böcker och hyllor när det som saknades var någon som kunde arbeta med samlingen"). The reciprocal direction also holds: verdicts-vfinal/verdicts-gstem.jsonl flags q:1 with "A and C are exact causal mirrors of one association … the direction is not decidable without the passage (lean C)" — and q2 B supplies exactly that missing direction (what was missing was the person, so staffing is the antecedent). The same re-run recorded q:2 "verdict": "pass" with empty findings, i.e. the two G-STEM runs disagree on q:2 and only the newer, more permissive one reaches reviews/final_verify.jsonl. Diff candidates-corrected→candidates-final touched only the passage register phrase, the q1 rationale, one trap label and self_blind_solve; no q1/q2 option text changed between the two G-STEM runs beyond the earlier "höjde"→"ökade" and "samtliga stadier som ingick i"→"samtliga stadier i" edits, neither of which affects the leak path.
findings.why: Held at minor rather than major on three grounds: the owning gate never escalated past "flag" (never kill) on either run and explicitly wrote "Mirror-pair distractors are legitimate design"; the coupling transmits the passage's thesis rather than a decidable key, so it lifts blind performance without making it deterministic; and a two-question single-thesis debattartikel cannot fully decouple its questions. Recorded so the owner can see that a gate-surfaced major was closed by a later pass with no written adjudication — the pipeline demonstrably does repair this class (reviews/pedagogy.jsonl las-b10-001: "Broke live cross-question leak: q:3 option C no longer names the 15 Sept frist"), so the silence here is a traceability gap, not evidence of absence.

findings.claim: q1 key C loosens two qualifiers of the passage finding beyond the three the rewritten rationale now accounts for: "minst tre dagar i veckan" becomes "flera dagar i veckan", and "en utbildad bibliotekarie" becomes "en bibliotekarie".
findings.evidence: Passage: "Där en utbildad bibliotekarie fanns på plats minst tre dagar i veckan tycktes undervisningen förändras". Key C: "Där en bibliotekarie fanns på plats flera dagar i veckan arbetade lärarna oftare med källkritik inom sin ordinarie undervisning." The final rationale enumerates hedging, stadie- and ämnesavgränsning (the prior audit's minor 2, now resolved) but not these two.
findings.why: Does not unseat the key or make C false: the paragraph-3 exception ("en bibliotekarie delades mellan tre eller fyra enheter", where "syntes ingen sådan förändring alls") cannot plausibly be read as "flera dagar i veckan" at one school, so the loosening admits no counter-case, and no other option is closer to the passage. Recorded as the residual edge of the same generalisation family the pedagogy stage already tightened.
